analyst.summary: SKF India is the local unit of the global bearings maker SKF, historically a high-quality, debt-free industrial business. Over the past year, however, both its automotive and general-industrial end markets have weakened at the same time, and the company's revenue and profit have both fallen sharply — profit is down roughly half from a year ago. Part of the decline reflects an unusually strong comparison base and a one-time tax charge, but the underlying weakness in demand is real and broad. Given the scale of the earnings decline and a valuation that doesn't yet reflect it, we would not add to or hold this position through the current downturn.
